handoff.purpose: Search and index status methods for EmbeddingStore.

symbols.name: search_report
symbols.note: Searches exactly one versioned index and returns a SearchReport with status, matches, spec, and freshness.

symbols.name: search
symbols.note: Compatibility wrapper that returns only matches from search_report.

symbols.name: list_indexes
symbols.note: Returns list of EmbeddingSpec from embedding_indexes table.

symbols.name: index_status
symbols.note: Returns IndexStatus for a given spec, including projection count, legacy count, freshness, and anchor.

symbols.name: legacy_unversioned_count
symbols.note: Returns count from legacy_agent_events_v1 table if it exists.

claims.text: Pass ``journal`` to have the result assert freshness against the authoritative journal.  Without it the report is ``freshness == "unanchored"``: the index may be arbitrarily far behind and this call cannot tell you.
claims.why: The behavior of journal_freshness and the freshness mapping is not fully defined in this chunk; the mapping includes 'unanchored' but the logic depends on journal_freshness method.
The code raises ValueError if metric != 'cosine'.

claims.text: pass either filters or individual provenance filters
claims.why: Code raises ValueError if filters is not None and any of project, trust, source is not None.

claims.text: This wrapper discards ``status`` and ``freshness``, so it cannot tell a drifted or stale index from a healthy one.
claims.why: The method returns only .matches from search_report, ignoring status and freshness.

observations.what: search_report returns early with status if backend.embed raises EmbeddingUnavailableError or EmbeddingProtocolError.
search_report returns early if _validate_batch raises TypeError or ValueError.
search_report returns early if index_id not found in embedding_indexes table.
search_report returns early if _verify_identity returns non-None drift.
search_report returns early if freshness_status.available is False.
search_report constructs SQL with filters and iterates over rows, computing cosine similarity and building AgentEvent.
search_report returns stale status if freshness == 'stale', else ready.
index_status returns index_unavailable if projection_count == 0, else ready with caveats.
legacy_unversioned_count checks for table existence and returns 0 if not present.
